# Release Tag Hygiene baseline (RELEASE-03)
#
# Format: one `<tag> <reason>` per line. Blank lines and `#`-prefixed lines
# are ignored. Adding a line here is an explicit, reviewable disposition —
# NEVER a way to make a *new* release failure quiet. Entries below are
# historical only: every tag listed here already existed at the time this
# guard was implemented (2026-08-11), and Actions run history / Release
# objects for the oldest of them predate reliable cross-referencing.
#
# To disposition a genuinely new tag, add a line with a real, specific
# reason and get it reviewed — do not copy the generic historical-baseline
# reason for a tag created after this file existed.

v5.9 malformed two-component tag, never matched release.yml's v*.*.* glob
v5.10.0 tag created locally, never pushed to origin
v5.11.0 PyPI-only release; Windows asset gap dispositioned per D-148-RELEASE04
v5.13 two-component tag; never matched release.yml's then-strict v*.*.* glob and was never pushed to origin. Milestone development completed, release did not happen. Record corrected in ROADMAP.md (RVW-004, 2026-08-25); v5.15 is the next real release. Trigger broadened to v[0-9]* so this cannot recur silently.
v5.14 two-component tag; never matched release.yml's then-strict v*.*.* glob, so pushing it fired no workflow. Tag contains version = "5.12.0". Milestone development completed, release did not happen. Record corrected in ROADMAP.md (RVW-004, 2026-08-25); v5.15 is the next real release. Trigger broadened to v[0-9]* so this cannot recur silently.
